finalText:
**Redis went down and took prod with it.** All times UTC.

```
02:14:07  Redis refused connections at 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:07  cache off, every read hit the store direct
02:29:12  request queue passed its limit of 500
02:31:44  worker-2 ran out of memory, restarted
02:31:52  api killed by supervisor, service down
```

All 13 reconnect tries failed, one per 80 seconds. Nothing else broke first.
